Scope of this claim (slice 1 of a family card): measure the boot chain on `origin/main`, then fix item 4 (`me/localization` sent twice) and item 2's serial boot edges that need no contract change (e.g. get-session waiting on me/localization; bundle, packages and ai/agents one after another). Items 1 (eager bundle; overlaps #33581, a seat-held big card) and 3 (data beside the lazy chunk) are measured and reported, not fixed here; the area files them as child cards from the dev's readings. The PR uses `Refs #35455`, not `Fixes`, unless the dev's measurement shows the Done-when holds.
File surface: the console boot path in `ui/packages/auth/src/` (`AuthProvider.tsx`, `createAuthClient.ts`, `createAuthenticatedFetch.ts`), `ui/packages/i18n/src/` (`provider.tsx`, `LocalizationContext.tsx`, `useDisplayLocale.ts`), `ui/packages/types/src/http-inflight.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/` (`console/ConsoleShell.tsx`, `hooks/useUserLocale.ts`, and the app-load providers that issue bundle / packages / ai-agents), their tests, root `.changeset/`. ⛔ No `packages/spec/**`, no server or REST source, no new endpoint, no `sharedUserFeeds.ts` (PR #35519), no plugin-detail source (#35437), no new i18n key. Stop on breach and report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default — no path-derived mandate`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: ui `auth`, `i18n` and `app-shell` in objectstack order the console's boot calls; no platform path covers it; every console user on every first screen, worst in hosted environments (objectstack-ai/cloud#4563 step 2 waits on this card)
Thread-read: 7006039384
Premise: holds as filed (measured by the filer on cloud main `8431db621`, objectstack pin `1aac465fe1d0`: about six serial round trips, me/localization twice); dev re-measures on `origin/main` first
Serial constraints cleared: no open PR touches the listed files (live read of all open PRs' files at claim time)
Pre-claim lane: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/{auth,i18n,types,app-shell}/**`)
Pre-claim deps: none (#33581 overlaps item 1 only, which this slice does not fix)
Prior rulings read: boot chain, me/localization, get-session, bundle → #34207/#34208/#34211 (probes removed from the chain, landed) and ruling 6999004977 on #34211 (page-load layer work measured by request layers) bind the measurement method; check-prior-rulings hits (ADR-0027 §12, ADR-0036 §1, ADR-0076 D10, ADR-0080 §2, ADR-0104 D2, ADR-0127 D6) are term matches, none rules on the boot order
